Since October 2025, I have received over 610 unsolicited prerecorded calls promoting supposed personal loans/debt relief. I have NEVER applied for a loan, answered these calls, returned a call, or consented to these solicitations. The callers continually rotate/spoof caller-ID numbers while directing recipients to recurring callback numbers using fictitious stories. Recent messages claim I have an existing “file,” that supervisors/underwriters have reviewed it, and, often lately, that numerous employees have repeatedly tried to reach me. This caller identified themself as "Frank" and offered an unsolicited $60,000 unsecured personal loan, saying i was one of a very few who had been approved. Other recordings use similar fictitious personal stories and loan approvals. I have preserved numerous voicemails, screenshots, dates, caller-ID numbers and callback numbers and have reported this to the FTC numerous times. This appears to be a large-scale, persistent robocall campaign, not isolated calls.

I received a call from someone claiming to be with my local sherrif's department in Adams County. They told me that I has missed jury duty and a warrant was out for my arrest unless I paid a fine. Not wanting to have anything on my record, I went along with their instructions and sent them money through Bitcoin.

Jobesh Solutions filed a claim with my health insurance company seeking $7,635.50. I have never heard of these people, I never saw any provider by that name, and it's supposedly for medical supplies on September 1, 2026. I didn't seek medical treatment on that date. I didn't order or receive any medical supplies. I don't know how they found out my name, date of birth, insurance and member and group number. I didn't give that out.

I was attempting to apply for a passport for my daughter and entered sensitive information thinking this was legit (obviously). I should have known better, but was eager to get this done. Luckily, my bank flagged the charge so they stopped the charge from going through, but I'm terrified that this will cause us problems in the future. I'm trying to freeze her credit, but she has no credit so I have to mail in a bunch of sensitive information to TransUnion, etc., (OR DO I??), so now I'm just scared to do anything. I feel like a complete idiot. I should've known better.

He said Chase received an application 9/22/26 and they issued a card on 10/1/26. He said the card number was **** **** **** **** but I do not have a Chase card account. He told me to contact the NYPD and use reference number CRW-****. He transferred me directly to the police department and spoke with NYPD officer Ashley Rodrijguez. She said her hotline number is 646-610-5000 and her badge number is ****. She said it was the 33rd District NYPD. I did not give information but they new my name, phone and the last two digits of my SSN. They said they would investigate and call me back. I did not supply them with any personal information.

I received 2 phones yesterday, 10/20/2026.  The first call came aat 1:07 pm informing me of Suspicious Bank Pending Transaction with Home Depot in Phoenix.  She claim to be calling from Chase Bank.  The 2nd call came at 2:09pm, same person.  She claimed the my Debit Card had in fact been compromised.  Did I want to get a replacement Debit Card sent regular mail or Expedited.  I said Expedited if there is no charge.  She agreed and proceeded to ask for my Password/ Bank Secret Code so she could process the Debit Card Replacement.  I said I NEVER GIVE out that information, especially over the phone.  I will go to the bank and request a Replacement Debit Card at the office!!  This ended any further discussion.  I contacted Chase to inform them of the Suspicious Bank Scam.

Orntli is a scam company pretending to sell products online but doesn’t not have them. They will tell you that their shipping has not synced yet so weeks will go by without any products that you bought. If you want to cancel they will tell you that there is a fee of 20% that they will deduct from your payment. They say they’re based in Norway, using an address there. They don not have any products.

They called me twice and the voicemail’s were “Yes, this is the Better Business Bureau.  My name is Anne Wildy.  This message is for the owner of the company.  Please return my call at 336-510-6907.  Um I'll be in my office till 4 PM.  And again, my number is 336-510-6907.  Thank you.…”
